text:
oliver_fin: Quick flag  found ~90 AWS Marketplace lines where `license_pool_id` points to the old reseller account. Seats are being billed to Reseller A instead of Reseller B after a contract migration last month.

sam.billing: Example row?

oliver_fin: Snippet from export: ```invoice_id,sku,customer_id,license_pool_id,units,amount
aws-2026-07-11-701,ml-pro-seat,acct-3344,pool-44321,50,2500.00
``` In our mapping table pool-44321 was moved to reseller-b on 2026-06-30 but the marketplace export still lists the old owner.

heidi_ops: Ingest logs show we map by license_pool_id -> reseller_id during ingest. If marketplace is lagging, we get misattribution. Pipeline is currently failing a consistency check and routing these lines to the "needs-manual-review" queue.

vendor_aws: We rolled a backend change that re-keyed pools; looks like the rekey event emitted but the downstream export job retried with cached metadata. We'll pull logs.

oliver_fin: Impact: about 90 lines across 40 invoices. Estimated revenue misattribution ~ $18,200. Need to reassign charges, issue credit memos and update partner payouts.

maya_revops: For accounting: we need CSV of affected invoice_ids and original vs desired reseller mapping. I'll need that to generate credit memos and reverse journal entries.

sam.billing: Mitigation plan: 1) hotfix ingest to consult the license_pool migration table with a TTL fallback (if pool migrated after export time, prefer the migrated owner); 2) reprocess affected export files from the storage bucket; 3) open a partner ticket and place any impacted invoices on revenue_hold until reconciled.

heidi_ops: Creating branch billing/fix-pool-mapping-fallback and adding unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/577. Will deploy to staging and run a reprocess job against the day's export. ETA 90m.

invoicebot: Attached export: s3://billing/exports/aws/2026-07-11/marketplace.csv (sha256: b1f9...) and queued reprocess job rc-20260711-pool-reassign-1.

vendor_aws: Confirmed: export retried with stale cache during a partial window at 2026-06-30T23:58Z. We'll add a fence to ensure rekey events are flushed before export job runs.

maya_revops: After reprocess please post the final matched count. If we need to issue credits, include a per-invoice breakdown. Finance will hold partner payout until reconciliation done.

oliver_fin: Follow-up: hotfix deployed to prod, reprocess completed 2026-07-11T15:20Z. 82 of 90 lines remapped successfully; 8 require partner confirmation. Generated credit memos for 38 invoices; 2 invoices await partner clarification. Closing loop once partners confirm those two. Thanks team.
